name: Connect hub
what: Everything connects to one thing: a hub in the middle, nodes popping around it one after another, each with a dashed curve drawing to the hub, then dots running along the lines - integrations, a team, a network, sources.

learned_from.what: a centre icon with app nodes connecting by dashed curves

motion: hub back.out 14 f + its halo turns; a node every 12 f (10 f) and its curve draws 14 f (S-curve); dots run 24 f, staggered
